release_notes:
• Front-Page Streak Challenge Module: Pick your streak target upfront (1-Day Kickstart, 3-Day Habit, 7-Day Consistency, 10-Day Challenge, 14-Day Momentum, 30-Day Master, or custom)
• Live Milestone Visual Tracker: Day-by-day checkmark bubbles and real-time streak protection status right on your Diary
• Camera Food Scanner: Snap meal photos to instantly compute calories and macros
• Enhanced achievements and gamification badges
